017package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.health;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
020
021import java.util.*;
022
023import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference;
024import org.apache.juneau.commons.inject.*;
025import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.*;
026import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.health.HealthAggregator.*;
027import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.servlet.*;
028
029/**
030 * Servlet flavor of the built-in health/readiness/liveness probe capability.
031 *
032 * <p>
033 * Mounts as a standalone top-level servlet at {@code /healthz}, {@code /readyz}, and {@code /livez},
034 * delegating to a shared {@link HealthAggregator} worker bean. The {@link HealthMixin} mixin flavor
035 * delegates to the same bean, so the two forms cannot drift.
036 *
037 * <h2 class='section'>See Also:</h2><ul>
038 *    <li class='jc'>{@link HealthMixin}
039 *    <li class='jc'>{@link HealthAggregator}
040 * </ul>
041 *
042 * @serial exclude
043 * @since 10.0.0
044 */
045@Rest(paths={"/healthz","/readyz","/livez"})
046public class HealthServlet extends BasicRestServlet {
047   private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
048
049   private final transient HealthAggregator aggregator = new HealthAggregator();
050
051   @SuppressWarnings({
052      "java:S2226" // Mutable by design: the embedded-server lifecycle publishes this post-construction, from a
053                   // thread other than the request-handling threads that read it via probe()/initReadinessState()
054   })
055   private final transient AtomicReference<ReadinessState> readinessState = new AtomicReference<>();
056
057   /**
058    * Publishes the lifecycle-owned {@link ReadinessState} that this probe should observe.
059    *
060    * <p>
061    * Called by the embedded-server lifecycle component (e.g. {@code JettyServerComponent},
062    * {@code TomcatServerComponent}) before the server starts, so the per-service instance that component flips
063    * on shutdown is registered into this resource's own bean store &mdash; see {@link #initReadinessState}
064    * &mdash; closing the gap between the microservice's bean store and this servlet's bean store that
065    * {@link HealthAggregator} consults.
066    *
067    * @param state The per-service readiness state.  Ignored if <jk>null</jk>.
068    * @return This object.
069    */
070   public HealthServlet publishReadinessState(ReadinessState state) {
071      this.readinessState.set(state);
072      return this;
073   }
074
075   /**
076    * Registers the {@linkplain #publishReadinessState(ReadinessState) published} readiness state (if any) into
077    * this resource's own bean store, so {@link HealthAggregator#aggregate} resolves the lifecycle-owned
078    * instance instead of falling back to {@link ReadinessState#shared()}.
079    *
080    * @param beanStore This resource's bean store.
081    */
082   @RestInit
083   @SuppressWarnings({
084      "resource" // addBean returns this; the discarded return is the store the caller already holds
085   })
086   public void initReadinessState(WritableBeanStore beanStore) {
087      if (readinessState.get() != null)
088         beanStore.addBean(ReadinessState.class, readinessState.get());
089   }
090
091   /**
092    * Health/readiness/liveness probe endpoint.
093    *
094    * <p>
095    * Serves all three mount paths ({@code /healthz}, {@code /readyz}, {@code /livez}) through one
096    * {@code /*} operation, dispatching on the request's last path segment.  A single zero-part,
097    * {@code hasRemainder=true} matcher is required because this servlet is auto-mounted at three <i>exact-match</i>
098    * top-level path-specs: a real container delivers a bare {@code GET /readyz} with a zero-segment
099    * {@code pathInfo} that no 1-segment matcher can satisfy, so three separate {@code @RestGet(path="/{probe}")}
100    * operations all 404.  The last-path-segment key ({@link #probeFor}) is the only thing that differs per mount,
101    * so it is the disambiguator.
102    *
103    * <p>
104    * This replaces the former {@code healthz(...)}/{@code readyz(...)}/{@code livez(...)} entry points; subclasses
105    * that overrode any of those must override {@link #probeFor(RestRequest)} (or this method) instead.
106    *
107    * @param req The request (its last path segment selects the probe).
108    * @param res The response.
109    * @return Aggregated health payload.
110    */
111   @RestGet(path="/*")  // Sibling-servlet pin (matches FaviconServlet/VersionServlet): a zero-part, hasRemainder=true
112                        // matcher that resolves BOTH a container's zero-segment bare-mount hit AND a mock/remount remainder.
113   public HealthResponse probe(RestRequest req, RestResponse res) {
114      return aggregator.aggregate(getContext(), indicators(), probeFor(req), res);
115   }
116
117   /**
118    * Resolves which probe this request is for, keyed off the LAST PATH SEGMENT.
119    *
120    * <p>
121    * Prefers {@link RestRequest#getPathInfo()} when it carries a real (non-root) value &mdash; this is what
122    * {@code MockRestClient} and any remainder-based remount populate ({@code servletPath="", pathInfo="/readyz"}).
123    * Falls back to {@link RestRequest#getServletPath()} for a real container's bare exact-match hit, where
124    * {@code pathInfo} is {@code null} ({@code servletPath="/readyz", pathInfo=null}).
125    *
126    * @param req The request.
127    * @return The resolved probe, or {@code null} for {@code /healthz} (the overall aggregate).
128    */
129   protected HealthProbe probeFor(RestRequest req) {
130      var hint = req.getPathInfo();
131      if (hint == null || hint.isEmpty() || eq(hint, "/"))
132         hint = req.getServletPath();
133      var last = lastSegment(hint);
134      if (eqa(last, "readyz", "ready"))
135         return HealthProbe.READY;
136      if (eqa(last, "livez", "live"))
137         return HealthProbe.LIVE;
138      return null; // "/healthz" (or anything else this instance is mounted at) -- overall aggregate.
139   }
140
141   private static String lastSegment(String path) {
142      if (path == null)
143         return "";
144      var p = path;
145      while (p.length() > 1 && p.endsWith("/"))
146         p = p.substring(0, p.length() - 1);
147      var i = p.lastIndexOf('/');
148      return i < 0 ? p : p.substring(i + 1);
149   }
150
151   /**
152    * Returns the indicators to evaluate for this request.
153    *
154    * <p>
155    * Defaults to every {@link HealthIndicator} bean registered in this resource's bean store.
156    * Subclasses may override to supply a fixed indicator set.
157    *
158    * @return Indicator map keyed by bean name.
159    */
160   protected Map<String,HealthIndicator> indicators() {
161      return aggregator.indicators(getContext());
162   }
163}
